summary: Mount Hood NF site in Clackamas County: a 1933 20-foot L-4 wooden tower, replaced in 1965 by a 41-foot R-6 tower; both sources list it as gone.

facts.design: 20-foot wooden tower with an L-4 cab (1933); replaced in 1965 by a 41-foot treated timber tower with an R-6 cab
facts.status_note: Both the register and firelookout.com list the lookout as gone; neither gives a removal date

notes_for_editor: Two thin sources that agree. No source gives the removal date, staffing, or what remains at the site. The brief coordinates (45.386522, -121.940748) match the register page's own coordinates (N 45 23.191, W 121 56.445). The weebly Oregon lookouts list also shows the site as removed, but its text was not quoted here.
